description: This file declares functions, constants, and includes related to monitoring within the wld (world) utility library. It defines the interface for monitor management such as initialization, destruction, status update, and configuration.

methods.name: wld_mon_initMon
methods.description: Initializes a monitor object with a specified callback, user data, and name.

methods.name: wld_mon_destroyMon
methods.description: Destroys or deallocates resources associated with a monitor object.

methods.name: wld_mon_writeActive
methods.description: Sets the active state of the monitor.

methods.name: wld_mon_sendUpdateNotification
methods.description: Sends an update notification related to the monitor's state.

methods.name: wld_mon_debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information for the monitor.

methods.name: wld_mon_setEnable_pwf
methods.description: Enables or disables the monitor (possibly as a property-write flag).

methods.name: wld_mon_setInterval_pwf
methods.description: Sets the monitoring interval (possibly as a property-write flag).
